__comment: A future ScreenBlockEntityRenderer will read FACING and rotate the model itself, exactly as ReceiverBlockEntityRenderer already does for the receiver's ROTATION - see ReceiverBlock's own blockstate comment for the same trap. These 'y' values exist to satisfy every state combination having a model, not because anything currently draws from them: ScreenBlock.getRenderShape is ENTITYBLOCK_ANIMATED, and until that renderer exists a placed screen draws nothing at all.
